question_text: What was the average head_count at FoodCourt_North during lunch hours 12:00 to 14:00 UTC on 2025-12-08?

retrieved_communities.summary: Cameras involved: DemoBooth_Intel (CAM_04), DemoBooth_NVIDIA (CAM_05), ExpoFloor_MainAisle (CAM_06), FoodCourt_North (CAM_07), KeynoteHall_Stage (CAM_08). Events are dominated by person movements (person_entry 206, person_exit 181, total 387) versus vehicle events (car_entry 29, car_exit 33). The dataset covers the UTC hour range 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-08T23:00:00Z with events from 2025-12-08T00:02:26Z to 2025-12-08T23:59:14Z; total events 449, peak head_count 500, average head_count (mean of means) ≈ 31.1974. Peak event count per hour is not provided in the supplied data.

All activity was recorded at Platform_1 between 2025-12-01T19:00:22Z and 2025-12-01T19:58:59Z (UTC). A total of 53 events were detected in that hour, dominated by person movements (21 person_entry, 20 person_exit) with car events less frequent (6 car_entry, 6 car_exit); peak event count for the hour was 53. Average head count (mean of means) was 34.98 and the peak head count observed was 42. Node count: 55.

All activity was recorded on Platform_1 between 2025-12-01T21:00:18Z and 2025-12-01T21:59:11Z (hour 2025-12-01T21:00:00Z UTC). A total of 41 events were logged: 31 person events (14 person_entry, 17 person_exit) and 10 car events (7 car_entry, 3 car_exit), so person movement dominated. Peak head_count was 14 with an average head_count mean-of-means of 4.95; the peak event count for the hour was 41 and node_count was 43.

All activity was recorded on Platform_1 during the 00:00 UTC hour of 2025-12-01 (events between 2025-12-01T00:02:02Z and 2025-12-01T00:57:29Z). There were 36 events total: 24 person events (8 person_entry, 16 person_exit) and 12 car events (7 car_entry, 5 car_exit), with person movements dominating. Peak head count observed was 13.0, the average head_count mean-of-means was 5.02, and the peak hourly event count was 36; node_count reported as 38.

citations.cypher:
MATCH (ch:CrowdHour {camera_location: 'FoodCourt_North'})
WHERE ch.hour_utc >= '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z' AND ch.hour_utc < '2025-12-08T14:00:00Z'
WITH sum(ch.avg_hc * ch.event_count) AS weighted_sum, sum(ch.event_count) AS total_samples
RETURN CASE WHEN total_samples > 0 THEN weighted_sum / total_samples ELSE null END AS avg_head_count
